qEffort12Assessment: The reasoning is sound; the IMPLEMENTATION IS A NO-OP FOR ITS MAIN STATED PURPOSE, and I can show it two ways. CODE: cohortKey() collapses every replacement MP to 'replacement::ALL'. There are exactly 7 replacement MPs (batch-003 §Q-effort-5, restated in batch-004.md itself: '7 MPs'). MIN_COHORT was raised to 8. In triage.ts:285-288 the group is taken, and `if (group.length < MIN_COHORT) { group = byClubAll.get(r.club) }` — 7 < 8, so the pooled replacement cohort is DISCARDED on every single replacement MP and each falls straight back to their club-wide group (all tenure classes). That is exactly the club-wide fallback the batch-003 reflection asked to eliminate, and it now fires on 7 of 7 replacements instead of 3 of 7. The two changes cancel: raising MIN_COHORT to 8 killed the cross-club pooling introduced in the same commit. EMPIRICAL CONFIRMATION: (i) the validation showed sd unchanged at 0.323 to three decimals and distinct values 95→93 — a structural cohorting change that moves nothing is a red flag, not a reassurance, and it is exactly what a no-op looks like; (ii) this batch's divergence lens picked LIBOR FORMAN (ledger.json: tenure_class=replacement, tenure_days=55, component_divergence=1.308 — the highest in the army), i.e. a 55-day replacement MP took a divergence slot in the very batch that was supposed to stop tenure artifacts from taking divergence slots. His own dossier then explains the pick as 'krátký pětapadesátidenní mandát ... vysvětluje ... extrémní divergenci komponent'. The lens is still an artifact detector for the replacement class; Q-effort-12 only closed the role_window_mismatch and never_cast_ballot doors. SECOND, INDEPENDENT DISTORTION introduced by MIN_COHORT=8: the fallback chain gates the CLUB step at the same threshold, so any club with fewer than 8 members skips club-relativity entirely and is z-scored population-wide, while large clubs are z-scored cohort-wide. componentDivergence values computed on structurally different bases are then compared against ONE global threshold (>=0.9) and rank-ordered against each other — mixed yardsticks. Raising MIN_COHORT made this worse, not better, by pushing more rows to the population basis. Two clean fixes, either acceptable: use split thresholds (cohort>=8 for the primary, club>=3 for the fallback) so the fallback is a genuine intermediate; or exempt the pooled replacement cohort from MIN_COHORT (it is a deliberate design cohort, not an accidental small one) — or, best, drop the hard cutoff for James-Stein-style shrinkage toward the population mean, which removes the cliff entirely. Whatever is chosen, VALIDATE BY RANKING DIFF, not by sd: the batch validated non-degradation, never that the retune achieved anything. And the divergence lens should exclude tenure_class=replacement outright, the same way it excludes never_cast_ballot and role_window_mismatch.
kottSignalAssessment: The DESIGN verdict (defer, land as a gated lens over dossier text, not a blind prop; recency is a required field) is well-argued and I endorse it — the two-stage rule's behaviour on Macinka (correctly declines a committee coincidence), on public-office holders, and its honest retention of the Šrámková false positive are genuinely good probe hygiene, as is the explicit refusal to read 'did not fire' as 'clear' at 41% dossier coverage. But the FACTUAL premise underneath it — 'occupationDataExists: false ... a genuine absence of the underlying data' — does not hold, and two sources were missed or under-weighted. (1) CENTRÁLNÍ REGISTR OZNÁMENÍ (cro.justice.cz), the statutory conflict-of-interest register under zák. 159/2006 Sb.: every MP files oznámení o činnostech (other activities, INCLUDING employment and corporate roles), o majetku, and o příjmech. It is public — free access over the public data network, on registration/request — and it is the canonical, primary, re-fetchable source for exactly the Kott class the probe declared nonexistent. The probe never mentions it at any of its three checking levels, and this is not an obscure miss: TWO of this batch's own army dossiers already lean on journalism derived from it (Okamura — HlídačPes on 'majetkovém přiznání'; Radim Fiala — 'podle majetkových přiznání 2021–2023 z fondu čerpal cca 16 mil. Kč'). The batch is simultaneously using the register's output and declaring the register's data absent. Under kernel Authority ('loops register for FREE API keys/accounts autonomously; payment waits for the user'), CRO registration is squarely inside the loop's own authority. (2) VOLBY.CZ open data: the probe DOES name 'election-candidacy povolání declarations on volby.cz' but dismisses them as 'a bespoke new scrape'. That is an understatement — ČSÚ publishes candidate lists as a first-class Open Data XML product (PS2025_XML / the registration files), with a POVOLANI field per candidate, i.e. a structured declared-occupation value for all 207 MPs as of the election that seated them. It is the same class of artefact as the psp.cz UNL dumps this repo already ingests, not a scrape. Its real weakness is that it is self-declared and frozen at election date — a RECENCY limit, which is precisely the follow-up field the probe itself says the signal needs. Also worth re-checking before it hardens into doctrine: the probe's parenthetical 'short of a paid Hlídač Státu token'. Several army dossiers in this same batch successfully read hlidacstatu.cz/Osoba/Vazby pages (Ženíšek, Hoppe, Kolovratník), and Hlídač grants free non-commercial API tokens on request — the 'paid' framing should be verified rather than inherited. VERDICT: PARTIAL/defer survives as a shipping decision, but the batch note's justification ('the underlying raw data does not exist ... not a missed ingest opportunity') must be corrected to 'no occupation field exists IN THIS REPO or on psp.cz; two external open/primary sources (volby.cz POVOLANI, cro.justice.cz) do carry it and were not probed'. Left as written, this note would close a live ingest opportunity for future batches on a false premise — the most consequential kind of vault error.
crossBatchContradictions: THREE found, one of them systemic. (1) THE SOLVED OSVČ IČO IS BEING RE-OPENED AS UNSOLVED, IN PROSE THAT WILL PERSIST. Batch 003's Opus verification SOLVED 04627695: it is a real registered entity, the Agrární demokratická strana, whose ARES obchodniJmeno field is literally the string 'OSVČ' — re-confirmed by this batch's own Opus verification call ('the plain ARES record literally carries obchodniJmeno OSVČ, sídlo Všeruby, NACE 94920, vznik 2015-12-09'). Yet eight batch-004 army dossiers (Jurečka, Benda, Kovářová, Schrek, Okamura, Radim Fiala, Kupka, Kasal) describe it as an unresolved artefact and recommend 're-resolvaci' / removal — directly contradicting a solved, twice-verified finding, and they contradict each other on the count: Schrek says 'třetí výskyt', Kasal 'čtvrtým výskytem', Kupka 'čtyři nezávislé dossiery', Benda 'pátý výskyt'. batch-004.md then aggregates this to '6+ occurrences across batches 003–004', while batch-003 established 10 of 13 money-linked MPs, repo-wide by construction. Root cause is a briefing gap, not agent error: the army's inputs never carried batch-003's solved-facts list. This is the clearest instance in the batch of the vault failing at its one job (being memory). (2) LIBOR FORMAN vs KAREL BERAN. Forman's dossier says he replaced Beran, 'který se v listopadu 2025 vzdal mandátu'. Batch 003 established deterministically that Beran departed 2026-05-29 after 238 served days, and that Forman's own mandate arose 2026-05-29 (55 days) — a figure Forman's SAME dossier quotes. So the dossier is internally inconsistent and breaks the Beran↔Forman reconciliation batch-003's handoff explicitly recorded as clean. (November 2025 is when Beran's SUCCESSOR-class colleagues seated; Forman is being confused with the 2025-11-03 replacement wave.) (3) LEDGER.JSON CONTRADICTS PAYLOADS/BATCH-003-TENURE.JSON. Batch 003's headline fix was making the tenure classifier end-date-aware (4 classes: full_term/replacement/departed/never_seated) after the Opus reflection caught the fromAt-only version misclassifying all 7 vacated seats. That fix landed in tenure.ts only. triage.ts:132-135 still carries the OLD two-class fromAt-only classifier, so the git-tracked machine state written this batch says Karel Beran = full_term / 293 days, Markéta Šichtařová = full_term / 293, Josef Kott = full_term / 293 — all three departed MPs, all three carrying the artefact batch 003 shipped a fix for. This is not cosmetic: the bottom lens filters on r.tenureClass and the divergence cohorting keys on it, so both consume knowingly-wrong values, and any future session resuming from ledger.json inherits the pre-fix state. Positive control: Kotlík (replacement/35), Nerušil (replacement/135) and the Kott↔Kotlík / Šichtařová↔Nerušil threads all still reconcile on substance — the contradiction is in the derived state, not in the analysis.
doubleVerificationValueAssessment: Worth it, but not for the reason the batch note gives, and the cheap half should be redesigned rather than repeated. The two passes did NOT catch different things — one caught nothing. The driver's own curl pass returned 'every driver-checked claim matched the Sonnet rewrite's finding' across 13 IČO: zero marginal yield, by construction, because it re-checked exactly the entities the rewrite had already chosen to check. It was a CONFIRMATION-SCOPED pass, and a confirmation-scoped second look can only ever find transcription errors, never omissions. Every one of the dedicated Opus call's material findings was an OMISSION — an IČO sitting in the MP's own linkedCompanies list that the dossier never looked up at all (Foldyna's Dopravní podnik Děčína 62240935 against 1M CZK; Výborný's Gymnázium Pardubice 48161063 against 9.25M CZK, protected from re-checking by a prior CORRECTLY_HEDGED grade that was itself a plain-endpoint false negative). The value came entirely from SCOPE EXPANSION, i.e. from asking 'what did you not check', which is the question a fresh independent reader asks and a confirming reader never does. Two conclusions. (a) KEEP the dedicated Opus money call — it converted a 'persist-safe' payload into PERSIST-WITH-EDITS with two blocking errors of exactly the class the batch existed to eliminate; that is the third consecutive batch in which the Opus money call paid for itself, and this time it paid on omissions rather than on wrong facts, a genuinely new failure mode. (b) REPLACE the driver's curl pass with something deterministic that targets omissions: a coverage check that enumerates every IČO in each MP's linkedCompanies and asserts it appears in the dossier's text or citations, WARNing otherwise. That is ~15 lines, costs nothing, runs on all 43 proposals instead of 13, and would have surfaced BOTH of the Opus call's blocking findings mechanically — the same 'the cheapest quality upgrade is deterministic, not model-tier' lesson batch 003 drew, applied one level up. Net: the double verification was valuable AND partly redundant; the redundant half has an obvious deterministic replacement.
tieringVerdict: CHALLENGED on one axis, confirmed on the others. Confirmed: the Sonnet army is the right tier for dossier work — 35/35 gate pass, 176 citations, zero hallucinated ids, zero fabricated series, strong self-initiated hedging on failed lookups, real positive symmetry. Confirmed: two Opus calls is the right budget, and the reflection call must be given the batch's own new deterministic code (it was, and that is how the Q-effort-12 no-op surfaced — a defect no amount of dossier review would have found). CHALLENGED — the money-verification routing REGRESSED this batch and nobody logged it. Batch 003 routed 13 army money-crossover MPs plus the Kott lead to Opus. Batch 004 routed ONLY the 8 rewrites; the army's own new money claims got zero Opus attention, and they are not minor: Radim Fiala (signal 0.9 — the batch's highest, a hidden-beneficial-ownership accusation resting on media with a failed register lookup), Okamura (0.78, jednatel asserted from a wiki mirror), Kolovratník (0.72), Kovářová (235.5M CZK ČEPRO), Bauer (128.8M CZK Bosch), Záhoř (18.5M CZK with sources that openly disagree about his role). Kernel rule (b) is claim-type-based, not payload-based; scoping it to 'the rewrite payload' quietly converted it into a flag-based rule — the exact mistake the Kott case was supposed to have retired. And the kernel's conditional top-signal Opus trigger, which the doctrine says must stay ARMED and be fired on genuine severity, did not fire on a 0.9 signal. Second, smaller challenge: this batch's two most consequential defects (the MIN_COHORT/pooling no-op; the Havlíček mis-attribution that invalidated Q-effort-11's validation) were authored by the DRIVER, not the army — the driver's own deterministic code and its own validation claims are the least-reviewed artefacts in the loop, and they are the ones the ledger and every future batch inherit. Steering: keep the army on Sonnet, keep 2 Opus calls, but re-scope call 1 from 'the money payload' to 'every dossier in the batch making a personal-company-role claim or carrying contractCzk above ~10M, regardless of which payload it sits in', and treat driver-authored deterministic code as in-scope for call 2 by default.
